title: ownpurse ui error reply (v 1)
description: Every refusal of every `ownpurse ui` and classify-write command with --json. The codes and exit codes are in docs/TUI.md (Error codes).

error.description: The stable code (view_changed, view_mismatch, user_busy, too_small, not_found, …).

help.description: What to do next (always at least one line).

expected.description: view_mismatch: the predicates that failed {path, op, value}; too_small: the minimum size {cols, rows}.

actual.description: view_mismatch: the values found per failing predicate [{path, value, text}]; timeout (ui wait): the current values {rev, store_rev, record, running, idle}; too_small: the terminal's size {cols, rows}.

skipped.description: Classify writes: what was left alone.

anchors.description: user_busy on a classify write: the lines the user has open.
